Signature.label: Engine Options
Signature.value: The facelifted CX-5 was released in Japan on 8 November 2021. The facelift model saw the (25T) engine discontinued and, leaving only two gasoline models: 20S, and 25S. The XD grade has been consolidated into two grades: XD Proactive, and XD L Package.

Sport.label: Engine Options
